'''Jashvi''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith Saber]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Jashvi was part of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] infiltration team that took up residence in the newly abandoned [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], under orders of [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]].
